stock.description: Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding firm, primarily focuses on the production and distribution of various adhesive products. These include primers, hardeners, and specialized adhesives for vulcanized shoes, which are supplied to footwear manufacturers in major markets like the People's Republic of China, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Bangladesh. Beyond manufacturing, the company is actively involved in trading raw materials and adhesives, as well as offering a range of other chemical products for industrial applications. Its operations also extend to providing agency and administrative support services, alongside the processing and packaging of its adhesive offerings. Established in 1987, the company is headquartered in Macau. It was previously known as Infinity Chemical Holdings Company Limited before rebranding to its current name in February 2016. Infinity Development Holdings Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of All Reach Investments Limited.
